title: Bass Drop
blurb: That engineered moment where a build-up finally releases and the low end arrives all at once. The drop is the backbone of every hype edit on the internet, and the standard punctuation mark for reveals, transformations and slow-motion walk-ins. Producers spend an unreasonable amount of effort on the two seconds immediately before it, because the silence is what makes the impact land at all. Best used sparingly. Best used at a volume that makes somebody in the room check their speakers, then check them again.
origin: A generic EDM-style bass drop used across meme and hype edits.
